description: Destroy the MySQL database provisioned for a specific instance (by id or exact name), deleting every table and row inside it. There is no undo and no export. Call get_database_info first and make sure the user understands what is stored in it.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be permanently deleted (the database and everything stored in it is destroyed and cannot be recovered) and getting their approval.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: delete_database
title: Delete Database
